name: camera-shoot
description: Give your agent eyes: it takes photos with the cameras attached to your computer and looks at them. Ships with an empty config: on first use the agent discovers the platform, capture tool and cameras, works out camera permissions (building a tiny macOS helper app when the agent host can't get a camera grant), asks you for a default camera and what it'll be looking at, verifies a test shot, and saves it all to the skill's config.json. Later uses go straight to the capture. Works with macOS (imagesnap/ffmpeg), Linux (fswebcam/ffmpeg) and Windows (ffmpeg), and with any harness that loads SKILL.md skills (Claude Code, Mistral Vibe).
